reviews.title: Decent case
reviews.comment:
Cheaper case, but everything fits right and overall it looks pretty good. The metal is thin and the screw holes strip easily if over-tightened. Air flow and cable management weren't given much thought.
This may not be a good case for a computer with significant cooling needs, but for a midrange build it seems ok and is priced right.
reviews.author: Fuzz

reviews.title: overall quality control is lacking
reviews.comment:
1. The construction materials are somewhat soft and can bend too easily under pressure.
2. The tempered glass panel is of good quality, but overall quality control is lacking, since both units I received had quality control issues.
3. The manual is far too brief, poorly written, and printed so badly that it is hard to use.
4. The case itself has a very attractive design. It seems to be a copy of an Acer name brand case that is not sold in the U.S. market. It is impressively compact for a case that can still fit a micro-ATX board and a large triple-fan GPU, but assembling a system with it is a frustrating and painstaking process, because the interior is extremely cramped, and the vague instructions only make the build process more difficult.

reviews.title: Micro ATX is my new favorite Mini ITX
reviews.comment:
Very happy with this case. I love the console-like size, and the fact that the face of the pc is solid (no holes). Not so great for air flow, but perfect for stickering! The product info was missing a lot so here's what I found:
- The front panel connectors are a usb 3.0 header, a usb 2.0 header, HD audio header, and power with LED.
- The usb c port is hooked up to the usb 2.0 header. I've included images of the usb c and 3.0 ports speed tests.
- SFX power supplies fit very nicely inside the case. The instructions do say that a full size psu should fit, but I feel like cables would interfere with the GPU.
- I tried using a notcua 92mm fan I had lying around, but the hole in the case do not align. Noctua 120mm and 80mm fans fit perfectly tho.
- I'm surprised with how sturdy the case feels for the price.
During my testing, without any case fans the cpu stuck around 80 degrees C and with two 120mm fans at the bottom and one 80mm outtake in the back, cpu went down to low 70s.
The only negative thing I have to say for this case is that Im unhappy with the usb C port being hooked up the usb 2.0 speeds.
